objective: Reduce late fuzzy Top-K feature death with training-only balance objectives while preserving the exact parent forward model and matched-active-FLOP ladder coordinates.

prior_evidence.finding: Late zero activation is mostly whole-group ReLU death, with an additional within-group winner-concentration effect.

hypotheses.choice_balance: A population-level balance loss across the four choices in every fixed group prevents persistent winner monopolies without preventing token specialization.
hypotheses.group_survival: A squared hinge on negative group maxima directly prevents the larger failure mode in which all four features fall below ReLU.
hypotheses.combination: Choice balance and group survival address separable mechanisms and may compose better than either alone.
hypotheses.quality: A treatment can retain the parent fuzzy validation advantage while materially reducing late dead-feature fractions.

common.mlp: H=16D, K=4D, fixed group size G=4
common.evaluation_forward: ordinary parent fuzzy Top-K with no auxiliary computation

objectives.normalization: Choice statistics and alive loss are reduced over the complete global data-parallel batch; the selected layer losses are averaged across transformer blocks before applying coefficients.

controls: exact Switch coefficient 0.01 plus alive coefficient 1.0 at margin 0
hard-load bias coefficient 0.01 plus retained-deficit alive coefficient 1.0 at margin 0
throughput_gate.acceptance: Both runs complete standard validation and feature captures; balanced training time is no more than 25% slower than neutral, with approximately 20% the desired systems target.

exact_switch_plus_alive.decision: rejected for the long prototype screen

declared_cells.admission: rejected by the first soft-objective systems gate
held out unless a later optimized soft-objective gate passes
rejected by the first soft-objective systems gate
held out unless a later optimized soft-objective gate passes

prototype_screen.advance_rule: Prefer the lowest-complexity declared cell that materially lowers both dead-feature fraction and negative-group incidence versus neutral, preserves within-group winner entropy, and has no catastrophic cross-entropy or gradient-norm regression. Ties are resolved before inspecting other seeds.

mature_ladder.control_policy: Reuse the verified same-seed parent fuzzy diagnostic runs only after exact scientific-coordinate and source-provenance comparison.
mature_ladder.launch_policy: After selecting and versioning one mature treatment, launch nine cells sequentially in increasing tier and seed order. Never retry, select, or terminate based on scientific intermediate metrics.
mature_ladder.stopping_rule: Each admitted cell runs its complete explicit cosine schedule. A systems failure stops the sequential queue for inspection.

optional_extension.policy: Queue only after the mature smaller ladder if the accelerator window permits; otherwise retain as a separately declared continuation.

references.title: Scaling and evaluating sparse autoencoders
references.use: precedent for training-only auxiliary signals that target dead latent populations; its reconstruction-residual AuxK is not transplanted into this language-model MLP
